text: City of Irvine Councilmember/Attorney
Dear Neighbor,

For the past two years, I have had the privilege of serving as your City of Irvine Council District 1 Councilmember. When I ran as a new candidate backed by grassroots support in our community, I made our shared goals my policy priorities. We have delivered practical solutions to meet your needs in Council District 1 and Irvine.
In my first short term, I have accomplished critical services and infrastructures for public safety, education, and quality of life:

Initiated the first community center and library in Council District 1.
Expanded Irvine Connect to alleviate Northwood High School traffic.
Improved pedestrian safety citywide.
Ensured new housing projects meet strict fire standards. Promoted economic development for small and start-up businesses.
Created accessible housing options for young professionals. Developed a vital childcare program for working parents. Started an AAPI focused senior nutrition program using private funding.

I have listened closely to your concerns and delivered solutions with thoughtful deliberation, fiscal responsibility, and full transparency. Together, we can continue to ensure that Irvine remains the best place for families to live, work, and play.
Thank you for your continued trust and I humbly ask for your support to serve our community for the next four years.

Melinda Liu
Liu4Irvine.com

text: City of Irvine Commissioner/Businessowner
Every election, some candidates talk. They promise. They win. Nothing happens.

Residents still sit in traffic on Culver, worry about fire risk in our hillsides, and watch Irvine become less affordable. Our city council chases costly pet projects. Meanwhile the city faces a nearly $50 million deficit in just a few short years. Enough. It is time to get back to basics.

We have lived in District 1 continuously for 26 years, first in Northpark and now in Orchard Hills. We are still raising our family here, with our youngest currently in an Irvine public school. This is not a campaign stop. This is home.

I serve on the Irvine Finance Commission, having previously served as its Chairman, and have also served as Planning Commissioner and Transportation Commissioner. This experience will allow me to hit the ground running on day one.
This is not the time for nostalgia. We need forward-thinking leadership ready to tackle today's challenges.
My priorities: Fiscal responsibility, Public safety, Traffic relief, Fire mitigation, Open spaces and trails, Affordability, Educational leadership
I am endorsed by Orange County Sheriff Don Barnes and numerous elected officials who serve Irvine and Orange County.

Back to basics. Finally.
John Park
JohnPark4Irvine.com

text: Small Businessman/Educator
Irvine has been my home for more than three decades. My wife, Joanne and I raised our family here, and I have dedicated my career to serving our community with integrity, experience, and results.

I served two terms as Irvine Mayor and Irvine City Councilmember, leading our city through the Great Recession while maintaining balanced budgets without furloughs or core service cuts and while strengthening financial reserves. During my tenure, I secured more than $121 million in transportation funding, expanded community services, invested in education, and helped preserve Irvine’s reputation as one of America’s safest and best-managed cities.

Most recently, I served as a Presidential Appointee and Regional Administrator for the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), overseeing billions of dollars in federal assets and capital projects across eight states. This experience reinforced my commitment to fiscal responsibility, accountability, transparency, and protecting taxpayer dollars.

I am running for Irvine City Council District 1 to ensure responsible spending, strengthen public safety, support educational excellence, improve public transportation, promote local businesses, safeguard open spaces and promote thoughtful growth. Irvine deserves experienced leadership that puts Irvine residents first and delivers results.
I respectfully ask for your vote by November 3.
Website: sukheekang4irvine.com
Sukhee Kang
